overall: Evidence audit of 76 cards (62 chapter cards, 14 sealed): 42 keep, 33 fix, 1 cut. Axis directions match Sally throughout: Q05, Q21, Q24, Q41 put We on +R1; Q37 and Q25 put Direct on +R2; Q01, Q04, Q09, Q12 put Classic on +R3; Q17, Q19, Q33, Q46 put Steady on +L1; Q20, Q45, Q48 put Push on +L2; Q38 and Q40 put Rules on +L3. The capacity cards (C2-2, C2-7, C5-5) correctly score no R2, and there is no politics, no health item and no em dash in the chapters. Most fixes are one-line remaps, but four problems block shipping as is. First, three tag pairs can never fire: T08 and T10 have one card each and T11B has one, so the friend game's decoys for them are dead weight; the fixes on C2-3, C2-5, C5-3 and C6-9 close all three without adding run length. Second, R2 is fragile: only three cards, all in chapter 2, and C2-8 has its private-DM and wait-till-asked options inverted and rewards unsolicited looks critique; fix C2-8 and add one R2 card outside chapter 2. Third, teen safety: C6-7 feeds locked18 wedding tags from a teen card, and C6-3 is a kids topic with no teen prompt. Fourth, repetition, the exact failure of test 1: C5-3 reruns C4-2 (cut it), C4-11 reruns C4-9, 'already has a job' appears three times, 'Future me says thanks' twice, instant noodles twice, moving day three times, and C4-8 and C7-9 share a prompt. C5-9 reuses a prediction line the blind tester already rated in test 1, which would taint the retest. Smaller evidence drift: R1 keeps getting added to behaviors that are about friends or solitude, not your person or family (C1-4, C4-1, C4-7, C4-9, C7-6, C7-S2); a depends option scores (C7-3); and strengths are inverted on C5-6, C6-2 and C7-1. Cool answers to fix: C4-4 ($3 for shelter dogs), C7-7 (the saint ticket) and C5-9 ('a life that fits them exactly'). Structure: there are 14 sealed checks against the brief's 8, and 62 chapter cards plus 8 sealed is 70, over the 64 cap. The ch3-to-ch4 and ch2-to-ch3 boundaries put two scenarios in a row, and C6-3 and C6-9 are lone this_or_that cards. For the finale I would keep C1-9 (R1), C2-10 (R2), C6-S1 (R3), C5-S2 (L1), C5-S1 (L2), C7-S1 (L3), C2-11 (T05/T06) and C1-10 (T04). I would drop C3-10, C3-11, C4-10, C4-11, C6-S2 and C7-S2, and move the golden banner card C4-10 back into a regular slot if chapter 4 has room.
